CREATE DATABASE kline PRECISION 'ms';
SHOW DATABASES;
DROP STABLE kline.`kline`;
CREATE STABLE kline.`kline` (
`ts` TIMESTAMP,
`open` DOUBLE,
`close` DOUBLE,
`high` DOUBLE,
`low` DOUBLE,
`vol` DOUBLE,
`source` TINYINT,
`created_at` TIMESTAMP)
TAGS (`symbol` VARCHAR(64), `freq` VARCHAR(24));


CREATE DATABASE factor PRECISION 'ms';
SHOW DATABASES;
DROP STABLE factor.`factor`;
CREATE STABLE factor.`factor` (
`ts` TIMESTAMP,
`factor` DOUBLE,
`fq_type` VARCHAR(64),
`created_at` TIMESTAMP)
TAGS (`exchange` VARCHAR(64), `symbol` VARCHAR(64));
